profile_text.body:
Serve Robotics Inc. /DE/ is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Carlos, CA, trading under the ticker SERV with SEC CIK 0001832483. Its website describes the company as the future of sustainable, self-driving delivery, asking why move a 2-pound burrito in a 2-ton car. The company presents a low-emissions solution to the last-mile problem and says it is setting the standard for safety on and beyond the sidewalk, protecting customer data, employees, and the public.

The site names a delivery robot called Saymo, which it says moonlights as John Mulaney's trusty sidekick on the show "Everybody's Live." The company describes itself as already a pop culture icon. The website does not mention AI explicitly; it describes self-driving delivery robots.

Public records show 281 California legal exposure entries associated with the company, and no lawsuits are recorded for the company.
